reviews.reviewText: Overall paper bohat conceptual tha aur mostly MCQs depth mein se thay. MS Word mein se zyada MCQs thay (Home ribbon ke baray mein). XML abbreviation thi. Overall abbreviations bohat kam thin. COBOL ka 1 MCQ tha. C language mein '11 % 3' ka output poocha tha. Sirf highlighted points ya files karne se paper acha nahi hoga, handouts ko achy se prepare karain.
Paper easy tha. Majority handouts mein se aya hua tha, aur MS Office mein se ziada portion tha. Minority mein conceptual questions bhi thay but overall paper easy tha.

Paper was mostly from Handouts.
MCQs Topics:
- MS Word (Tabs, Tools, Shortcuts, Inserting Images, Illustration group) - 13-14 MCQs.
- MS Excel (Countif, Formulas) - 4-5 MCQs.
- MS Access - 6 MCQs.
- MS PowerPoint - 2 MCQs.
- Abbreviations (NLP, CSS).
- Coding: Condition finding, C++ Math (7/5, 10%4), While loop.
- Hash function, HTML attributes role.
- Semantic meaning in programming.
- Malware definition.
- Formal definition of algorithm.
Paper zyada tar handouts se tha. Abbreviations, binary system aur basic networking se conceptual questions aaye. Overall paper easy tha aur handouts parhne walon ke liye simple tha.
Final term paper mostly handouts se aaya. Bits and bytes, OSI model aur GUI se short conceptual questions thay. Definitions aur basics strong hon to paper easy lagta hai.
